Planned Parented Doesnt Sell Fetuses: The Real Story Behind That Shady Video

I am what most people would consider extremely pro-life, and I was stunned the first time I watched this video. Then I watched it again and thought about it, and concluded that the legal claims were overheated. I emailed a friend and predicted that PP's response would be that they don't "sell" tissue. They donate it and charge a nominal fee for medical supplies. In their own minds, what they are doing is not just ethical, but commendable. That all turned out to be true.

How a person responds to this video depends mostly on her attitude in general about abortion. If she's clearly settled in her own mind that a baby has no rights until it's born or maybe viable, then this won't seem like a big deal. It's medical waste being put to good use. (Some PP supporters have wondered whether it's ethical to alter surgical procedures for any reason except the health of the patient, but that's a side issue.)

On the other hand, if she is pro-life, the casual way the doctor in the video described over lunch intentionally crushing different parts of babys' bodies and reorienting babies to breach in order to harvest their heads is positively ghoulish, regardless of the legal questions.

I think the producers of this video made a strategic error by focusing on dubious legal arguments. It tends to discredit footage that would have been very powerful on its own in shocking some people out of complacency. The people I'm taking about may be uncomfortable with abortion but rationalize tentative support for PP anyway because of the other services they provide. Highly debatable claims about "selling" body parts has made PP look like the victim of propaganda.
